_about: Registry of this style's components (SYSTEM.md): what each one is, its kind and the regexes (sig) that find it in a built index.html. scripts/components.py plan / check / add / record read and write it: history lists your reels in order, projects maps a reel id to its project folder, and each element's reels say where it was used. Empty history = nothing used yet.
_about_components: kind = hook / scene / prop / frame / transition / outro (new every reel) or house (stays); sig = regexes (a LIST) on the built index.html; history = reels in order; projects = where each reel's index.html is.

elements.desc: every page: paper.png multiplied over the page + grain specks moved every 2 frames
1-3 halftone PNG layers per page (step 20-26, own screen angle, radial / edge / linear fields), multiply overprint
Playfair Display 900 headline, pink +0.055 em shadow, glyph pop with squash (back.out 1.9)
navy pill with pink offset shadow, Inter 900 54 px cream, yellow keywords, every spoken word in <= 25-char chunks
case number chip + chapter chip + REC dot/date, inverts on night pages, hidden on the hook
rubber stamp: double rounded box, Inter 900, PNG ink mask, 2.6x -> 1x in 0.09 s + bounce + page shake
90 px dot grid wipe, diagonal delay; full on page-page cuts, page half only on cuts touching the speaker's face
line boil: three jittered prop copies swapped at 10 fps via data-b on the page
the subject word behind the speaker's head on frame 0 (matte), fully set, no HUD
mugshot: height chart in cm, blue halo, the phone drawn as a kawaii suspect with glossy eyes, name plate, flash + squint, push-in
a real cover as a taped white-bordered print dropping in + a typed mono evidence label
giant Unbounded numeral, flat yellow + orange halftone via background-clip:text, rising from below
night page: phone lock screen + notification banners (envelope / bubble / heart) popping out on the spoken words, a stamp (OFF.)
numbered exhibit cards with halftone swatches + boiling icons (moon, dumbbell, heart), pins and a red string
the hard task as a mountain with a flag over a navy dot ramp, a reassuring stamp
day cells under a big phone that shrinks away, a yellow halftone bloom swells over the freed cells
a case-closed stamp below the speaker's face on the last line, no shake
